premise: Psittacosaurus and Turtle sit on the log to rest; every time Brachiosaurus stomps past, the log rocks — wibble, wobble — and after a surprise that turns to giggles they ask for more, until his slow stompy dance makes it the best ride in the valley.
inspiration: The nursery see-saw ('See Saw, Margery Daw') turned into a log that rocks to a giant's footsteps.
lesson: A surprise can turn into fun when friends share it.

en-US.title: The Wobbly Log
en-US.text: {log:enter} Little {psittacosaurus:enter} Psittacosaurus and {turtle:enter} Turtle had walked a long, long way. {psittacosaurus:face sad} "My feet are tired," said Psittacosaurus. {psittacosaurus:go on log} {turtle:go on log} So they sat down on the log to rest. Ahh. {psittacosaurus:face happy} Then, thump, thump, along came {brachiosaurus:enter} {brachiosaurus:go to log} Brachiosaurus. {sfx:stomp} THUMP! went his big foot. {log:live rock} And the log went {sfx:creak} wibble, wobble, wibble! {psittacosaurus:face surprised} Psittacosaurus held on tight. {turtle:live hide hold} Turtle pulled her head right in. [warmly] "Oh! Sorry!" said Brachiosaurus. {brachiosaurus:live stomp} He took another step. THUMP! {log:wobble x2} Wibble, wobble! {psittacosaurus:face happy} And this time, Psittacosaurus {psittacosaurus:live laugh} laughed and laughed. [excited] "Again! Do it again!" {turtle:live hide resume} Turtle popped her head out. {turtle:face happy} "Again!" So Brachiosaurus did {brachiosaurus:live dance} a big, slow, stompy dance, thump, thump, THUMP, {log:wobble x3} and the log rocked and rolled with the two little friends on top, squealing with joy. [happily] The best ride in the whole valley. All it needed was one log, and one very big friend with very big feet.

es-ES.title: El tronco que se meneaba
es-ES.text: {log:enter} El pequeño {psittacosaurus:enter} Psitacosaurio y {turtle:enter} Tortuga habían caminado mucho, muchísimo. {psittacosaurus:face sad} —Tengo los pies cansados —dijo Psitacosaurio. {psittacosaurus:go on log} {turtle:go on log} Así que se sentaron en el tronco a descansar. Aaah. {psittacosaurus:face happy} Entonces, pum, pum, llegó {brachiosaurus:enter} {brachiosaurus:go to log} Braquiosaurio. {sfx:stomp} ¡PUM!, hizo su patota. {log:live rock} Y el tronco se meneó: {sfx:creak} ¡zis, zas, zis! {psittacosaurus:face surprised} Psitacosaurio se agarró fuerte. {turtle:live hide hold} Tortuga metió la cabeza en su caparazón. [warmly] —¡Ay, perdón! —dijo Braquiosaurio. {brachiosaurus:live stomp} Dio otro paso. ¡PUM! {log:wobble x2} ¡Zis, zas! {psittacosaurus:face happy} Y esta vez, Psitacosaurio {psittacosaurus:live laugh} se partió de risa. [excited] —¡Otra vez! ¡Otra vez! {turtle:live hide resume} Tortuga sacó la cabeza. {turtle:face happy} —¡Otra! Así que Braquiosaurio se marcó {brachiosaurus:live dance} un baile lento y pesado, pum, pum, PUM, {log:wobble x3} y el tronco se meneaba y se meneaba con los dos amiguitos encima, chillando de alegría. [happily] El mejor columpio del valle. Solo hacía falta un tronco y un amigo muy grande, con unos pies muy grandes.

stomp.prompt: one huge gentle footstep on soft grassy ground, a deep soft thud, realistic
